en: A vintage illustrated postcard showing four playful kittens against a light beige background. One kitten at left carries a small pastry-like ring in its mouth, the second wears a blue ribbon and touches an orange ball, the third crouches low with black-and-white fur, and the fourth at right holds a bundle of sticks or wrapped item in its mouth near a small apple. The card is slightly aged with a postmark stamp on the right side and cursive handwriting along the bottom.
